brief_ref: §13 (do not force matches -- the ventilation example, verbatim)
description: Old schedule has 'Install ventilation ducts - Floor 2'. New schedule has three plausible-but-not-identical candidates: 'Install ventilation - Floor 2', 'Install ventilation ducts - Floor 3', 'Install main ventilation - Floor 2'. None shares an exact name+location key with the old activity. Brief §13 requires Nova not to guess which one it is.
notes: Today's baseline already satisfies brief §13: with no exact name+location key match, the old activity lands in 'removed' and all three new candidates land in 'added' -- none is force-matched, and no wrong pairing is silently produced. What is missing (tracked for Phase 3, TL-3.1..TL-3.4): the engine has no 'ambiguous / requires verification' bucket -- these four activities are indistinguishable in the output from a genuine, unrelated add/remove. Phase 3 should turn this into an explicit ambiguous-match state without changing the fact that nothing gets force-matched.
